title: E-FND-0083: the induced map of the momentum rule on two-tone pairs at one cell is a permutation: all 1104 two-tone...
purpose: Experiment E-FND-0083 in the foundations arena: the induced map of the momentum rule on two-tone pairs at one cell is a permutation: all 1104 two-tone states land on 1104 distinct images (the head-on rotation swaps two lines and fixes everything else), so a pair is as classical as a single tone, while the irreversible sorting collision merges the same states.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
